title: Ghairat Da Kaaba Logon Mola Mera Sajjad Ay
body:
Bhulaya Nahi Shaam Aj Thaak Har Maur Enu Yaad Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Gal Tauk Zakmi Taliyan Aadat Nahi Turandi
Tak Sar Barehna Phuphiyan Karda Duan Marandi
Zainab Da Magna Chaadar Ki Ay Dard Ay Bula Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Nahi Rhondi Ay Sakina Zalim Shimr Ton Dardi
Takdi Tay Koray Lag Day Fariyad Vi Na Kardi
Ruk Day Shimr To Chumdi Aakay Zakam Bhira Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Aabid Nu Waqt E Aqir Rokay Sakina Kehdi
Babay Day Naal Aana Menu Milan Abbas Ay
Chehray Tay Ungli Aakahy Veeran Nishan Mita Day
